create_tacz.ponder.bullet_factory_1.head: Making Ammunition by Hand
create_tacz.ponder.bullet_factory_1.text: Ammunition can be crafted at the Ammo Assembly Table
But it cannot be hooked up to an automated production line
Ammunition can only be made by hand
Which is an extremely unhealthy practice
create_tacz.ponder.bullet_factory_2.head: Making Ammunition Automatically
create_tacz.ponder.bullet_factory_2.text: Supply stress to the Military Factory
Its speed must be at least 16 RPM
Put the ammunition you want to craft (only one type) into the list filter
Remember to set it to whitelist and to match item NBT
The Military Factory pulls ingredients from adjacent inventories
Crafting speed depends on rotation speed
At 256 RPM it produces one batch every 5 seconds
Finished ammunition can be taken out with funnels and other logistics
